notes: Issue #2919 calibration baseline for the surrogate cold-start gate. The dummy fixture (193 bytes, pass-through on input[0]) is intentionally tiny so session-construction cost (~10 us) dominates the cold path — cold/warm ratio naturally ~3x even with no regression. The CI gate's `cold_start.trivial_fixture_ms = 5.0` skips the absolute 1.5x ratio check when cold_ms < 5 ms (always true on the dummy fixture), and uses this baseline + the 25% regression tolerance as the binding signal. The 1.5x absolute ratio check fires on real workloads (256 MiB shipped model, cold ~400 ms). Regenerate via: cargo test --release --features ort --test surrogate_cold_start_test -- --ignored --nocapture diagnostic_print_cold_warm_cycles
